prompt.en: What is Magna Carta also called?
prompt.fr: Quel autre nom donne-t-on à la Magna Carta?

options.en: The Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms.
options.fr: La Charte canadienne des droits et libertés.

options.en: The Bill of Rights of the United States.
options.fr: La Déclaration des droits des États-Unis.

explanation.en: Magna Carta, signed in England in 1215, is also known as the Great Charter of Freedoms. It is not the same document as Canada's own Charter, which came much later.
explanation.fr: La Magna Carta, signée en Angleterre en 1215, est aussi connue sous le nom de Grande Charte des libertés. Ce n'est pas le même document que la Charte canadienne, qui est beaucoup plus récente.

source.quote: Together, these secure for Canadians an 800-year old tradition of ordered liberty, which dates back to the signing of Magna Carta in 1215 in England (also known as the Great Charter of Freedoms)

verification.evidence: the signing of Magna Carta in 1215 in England (also known as the Great Charter of Freedoms)
